title: Spicy Indian Fish Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic fish curry recipe, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This spicy dish is made with fresh fish, a blend of Indian spices, and a hint of coconut milk.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the fish fillets and cook until they are browned on both sides.
Add the Indian red chili powder, garam masala, cumin powder, and salt. Mix well.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry cook for 10-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with rice or roti.
